question:
**Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.**

Departure from common rule
solution:
The correct answer is: **Anomaly**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Anomaly **means a departure from the common rule or something that deviates from the norm. (सामान्य नियम से विचलन या कुछ ऐसा जो आदर्श से भटक जाता है)
 
• It is a noun and can be used in a sentence like "*The sudden surge in sales was an anomaly in the otherwise sluggish market.*"
 
• It is often used in scientific contexts to refer to an observation or result that cannot be explained by existing theories or models.
 
• Other synonyms for anomaly include aberration, deviation, and irregularity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Quixotic **means overly idealistic or impractical, often to the point of being unrealistic. (अत्यधिक आदर्शवादी या अव्यवहारिक, अक्सर अवास्तविक होने की हद तक)
 
• **Pragmatic **means practical and realistic often focused on achieving practical goals rather than pursuing idealistic or theoretical ones. (व्यावहारिक और यथार्थवादी अक्सर आदर्शवादी या सैद्धांतिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने के बजाय व्यावहारिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने पर केंद्रित होते हैं)
 
• **Stupor **means a state of dazed or unconsciousness, often caused by drugs or alcohol. (स्तब्ध या बेहोशी की स्थिति, जो अक्सर नशीली दवाओं या शराब के कारण होती है)
